content.text: No liquidated-damages, penalty, or early-termination-fee construct payable by us exists anywhere in this agreement, so I will submit a compliant finding without a redline.

input.quote: Upon any such termination, Contractor will be paid all fees and expenses that have been incurred or earned in connection with the performance of the Services through the effective date of such termination.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, stipulated-damages, minimum-fee or early-termination-fee construct payable by Clear Capital. Termination is available to either party for any or no reason on 15 days' notice (§ 6(a)) and on uncured material breach (§ 6(b)), and the only payment consequence in §§ 6(b) and 7(c) is Contractor's actual fees and expenses "incurred or earned … through the effective date of such termination" — compensation for work actually performed, not a liquidated amount. Compensation (§ 3) is time-and-materials with no late-payment penalty, non-refundable minimum, or termination charge; the non-solicitation clause (§ 13) carries no placement or buy-out fee; and § 7 caps liability by reference to fees paid rather than stipulating damages. This meets the preferred position that Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties, so no redline is proposed. Noted only for completeness: § 5's anti-bribery clause and the liability caps operate in our favour or neutrally and are not liquidated-damages exposure.
